character.name: A chibi kawaii character: an oversized round chubby golden cat shaped like a melting ice cream scoop, overflowing and spilling over a tiny waffle cone much smaller than the cat. The cat's soft body oozes and drips down the sides of the cone like melting ice cream, creating adorable drip shapes. Folded ears, small yellow eyes, open mouth, blushing cheeks, tiny stubby paws peeking out from the melty body. A small strawberry hair clip on one ear. Black fur with purple highlights and purple shimmer accents. Pixel art style with clean defined pixels. Digital illustration, artistic, stylized. Serene, peaceful, cute expression. Warm palette with deep purples, golden yellows, and waffle pink tones. Transparent-style checkered background (gray and white checkerboard pattern). Front-facing view, centered composition. Professional quality
